semantics.token: A venue-traded token described by the issuer as a proportional interest in its physical U3O8 pool.
semantics.guidePrice: The issuer guide price is a reference estimate and is not a formal token peg.
semantics.storage: Issuer documentation says the physical material is stored with Cameco and Archax acts as trustee; dated balance statements remain separate evidence.
semantics.marketBoundary: Venue quotes, order books, volume, and trades do not prove physical backing, deposits, exchange inventory, liquidity quality, or redeemability.

krakenListing.note: Manual dated listing receipt. The public-tape first trade is recorded separately and Kraken is not treated as proof of backing.

ownership.issuerDescription: Each xU3O8 records a unit of ownership in physical U3O8 held by Archax for investors; the unit represents an equal proportion of the pooled material.
ownership.currentSemantics: Proportional beneficial co-ownership share; not a permanently fixed one-ounce entitlement.

redemption.condition: Physical delivery is limited to regulated persons; an approved regulated warehousing/conversion account may receive a book-entry credit transfer.

transfer.issuerRestriction: Issuer documentation says xU3O8 may be held at approved venue addresses or wallets whitelisted for the dApp.

fees.currentStatusNote: No safe current-rate receipt was encoded; the published ceiling is not treated as evidence of the amount presently charged.

rights.note: The MiCAR whitepaper explicitly excludes governance, voting, and equity rights. No equally explicit reviewed statement about profit-sharing rights was located, so that field fails closed.

terms.caveat: Issuer descriptions and restrictions are reviewed public claims, not independent legal conclusions. Consult current terms before acting.

kraken.note: The first-trade timestamp is the first trade currently observable on Kraken public market data, independent of the dated listing announcement.

semantics.statedMethod: predictive estimate aggregating and filtering correlated financial instruments

oracle.note: This reference estimate is kept separate from token venue quotes and the dated physical balance statement.

proof.characterization: dated balance statement, not described here as an audit
proof.note: The statement date is the physical-balance clock. Retrieval time only records when this file was checked.

derived.method: Stoichiometric conversion of kgU-as-U3O8 to U3O8 mass using standard atomic weights, then pounds/ounces and per-token ratios.
derived.caveat: A cross-source estimate with non-matching clocks. It does not establish a formal peg, current backing, redeemability, exchange inventory, or proof by Kraken.

token.note: Capabilities are verified-ABI surface area, not evidence that a privileged action occurred.

companionApp.name: UraniumRefinery
companionApp.note: UraniumRefinery is a separate verified companion app and is not presented as the xU3O8 token controller.

protocol.name: Uranium.io
protocol.description: Uranium.io (XU3O8) enables investors to own and trade Uranium ore concentrate (U3O8), also known as ‘yellowcake; in an investment friendly and transparent manner by administering fractional ownership of physical uranium in the form of a smart contract ledger.

krakenMarket.label: Kraken public market API
krakenMarket.credit: XU3O8/USD pair metadata, ticker, OHLC, order book, and public trade tape

krakenListing.label: Kraken listing announcement
krakenListing.credit: Manual dated receipt that XU3O8 trading was announced live on Kraken

coinGecko.label: CoinGecko
coinGecko.credit: Uranium token quote, market history, supply, and venue-attributed tickers

coverage.historyClock: CoinGecko daily UTC history; the final point may be the API latest observation rather than a completed UTC day.

blockscoutToken.label: Etherlink Blockscout token API
blockscoutToken.credit: xU3O8 token metadata, counters, top-holder page, and latest transfer page

coverage.topHoldersNote: First Blockscout holder page only; address labels are context, not ownership proof.
coverage.recentTransfersNote: Latest Blockscout transfer page only; methods and labels are indexed context.

blockscoutContracts.label: Etherlink Blockscout verified contracts
blockscoutContracts.credit: Verified proxy lineage, implementation ABI capabilities, and separate companion app identity

etherlinkRpc.label: Etherlink mainnet RPC
etherlinkRpc.credit: Current read-only xU3O8 contract flags and total supply

defiLlama.label: DefiLlama
defiLlama.credit: Uranium.io protocol TVL and daily TVL history

coverage.methodology: Counts the balance of tokens in the XU3O8 contract

uraniumOracle.label: Uranium.io guide market price
uraniumOracle.credit: Current issuer-published uranium guide market price

uraniumIssuer.label: Uranium.io issuer documentation
uraniumIssuer.credit: Reviewed token, price-discovery, storage, and proof-statement semantics

proofOfReserves.label: Uranium.io proof statement
proofOfReserves.credit: Issuer-linked Cameco contract balance statement; parsed as a dated statement, not described as an audit

unavailable.label: Kraken xU3O8 inventory, deposits, withdrawals, and net flows
unavailable.reason: Public market-data endpoints expose trading activity, not Kraken custody inventory or complete deposit and withdrawal ledgers.

unavailable.label: Real-time physical backing ratio
unavailable.reason: The physical statement, guide price, chain supply, and venue quote have different clocks. The chamber shows a bounded estimate without presenting it as real-time proof.

unavailable.label: Beneficial owners behind top token addresses
unavailable.reason: Explorer names and contract labels are address context, not proof of beneficial ownership.
